title: Army money continues after the Round Table closes

tellings.quote: But, it all the while he was getting money from the Army. I mean, there's records of that.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about a 1957 group in Maine called the Round Table, linked in the episode to a scientist said to have contacted an alien council. Malatzi says that even after the group closed, its leader kept getting money from the US Army, and that records show this. If true, it would mean the military was quietly backing contact work.
